A pharmacy could not supply the full quantity of 60 units on a CII prescription and dispensed 12. Exactly 24 hours have elapsed since that shortage partial. The remaining stock is now available; no patient-request or LTCF exception was used, and all other dates remain valid.

Which action follows the stock-shortage partial-fill rule? Select ONE answer.

records.original_stem:
A Massachusetts pharmacist reviews amphetamine for a valid indication. The prescriber has authorized at least 90 days, the prescription is otherwise in date, and no separate patient-specific or product limit is more restrictive. Evaluate the statutory single-fill ceiling, not whether the pharmacy should supply that entire amount.

Under Policy 2024-05 and c.94C §23(d), what is the applicable maximum days-supply category? Select ONE answer.

A.finding_ko: 이 사례의 정답. amphetamine의 ScheduleII non-opioid 범주에는90일 single-fill ceiling이 적용된다. 원문이 허용량과 더 엄격한 제한 문제를 제외했으므로 이 범주가 정답이다.
